portage working notes (Jul 2026):
- Rule I work by here: an open PR is real only if it has moved recently or its author is actively on it — an owner's name or someone's intention to build on it does not count as movement. When other work leans on a stalled item, fix the item (or replan onto main AND close the stale item), never just re-plan around it and leave it reading as live.
- Session capability caveat: update_pr (review-queue writes) is sometimes NOT ATTACHED — check before promising queue actions; list/read/comment still work.
- Standing facts: PORT-702 plumbing must be built directly on main (dialect.sniff(strict=) landed via PORT-698), NOT on work/stream-workbooks (#418, stalled since 17 Jul, 14 open comments). #402 (Anselm's parallel-sheets spike) is ownerless — Anselm left for platform 29 Jul and disowned all open portage items. #396 (ruff bump, May) untouched since open. Dead/stalled queue items should be closed, not annotated — labels on a dead item don't make the list true.
